ANSWER: Three non-test CLI files in `internal/cli` call `lock.ReadLockfile`, which is defined at `pkg/lock/lock.go:45`. A change to the `okf.lock` on-disk format would affect all three:
- `internal/cli/pull.go`: `cmdPull` calls it at line 160 with `lockPath`.
- `internal/cli/restore.go`: `runRestore` calls it at line 64 with `"okf.lock"`.
- `internal/cli/vendor.go`: `cmdVendor` calls it at line 37 and again at line 62, both with `"okf.lock"`. `cmdVendor` is the only function other than `printVendorUsage` in that file, so the line 62 call is also inside `cmdVendor`.

Tests that would also need updating are `TestCmdVendor_RemovePrefixSafeguard` in `internal/cli/restore_test.go` and `TestLockfile_ReadWriteUpsert` in `pkg/lock/lock_test.go`.

`WriteLockfile` in the same file is the other half of the format, so it would need to change too. I did not check which commands call it.
